capabilitiesMatrix.notes: User explicitly picks folder via Picker. drive.file authorizes folder metadata.
Pre-existing files inside folder return 404 under drive.file; require broader restricted scope for automatic discovery.
Files dropped into folder via drive.google.com lack per-file grant under drive.file.
Nested subfolders must be individually picked under drive.file; once picked, nested tree is preserved.
Explicit Picker selection grants per-file access under drive.file.
Files created by Daynori inside folder are authorized under drive.file.
Daynori NEVER deletes remote Drive originals on disconnect or unlinking. Status transitions to source_unavailable.
Token revocation or permission loss transitions link to permission_lost / revoked.
Page tokens chunk authorized items without crossing folder boundary.
Short-lived access tokens expire; refresh tokens sealed with AES-256-GCM + AAD.
Disconnect wipes tokens, increments generation, cancels jobs, preserves imported copies.
